'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Joe Giannetti DS Spice Mine Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joe Giannetti]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Spice Mine Operations]]
* '''Username:''' Sigga
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
